changes.name: Bayan Khundii Gold Mine
changes.owner: Erdene Resource Development Corp. / Mongolian Mining Corporation (50:50 economic JV through Erdene Mongol LLC)
changes.previous: 2026-11-04 Q3 company results: Q3 gold production/sales 11,853 oz, processed 164,000 t ore at 2.3 g/t, and Dark Horse heap-leach assessment; no formal updated 2027 annual gold target in Q3 release. In the later CEO interview the previous Dark Horse satellite-pit ore schedule is described as 2028.
changes.current: 2026-11-20 CEO interview (published Nov 21): Bayan Khundii 2027 production target ~70,000 oz gold (management aspiration), with Dark Horse high-grade (~50 koz at ~7 g/t as described by CEO) proposed to advance from 2028 to mid-2027 subject to Q1 2027 decision. Management considers heap-leach construction late 2027/early 2028, then ~20% CIP plant throughput uplift; ~100,000 oz/y eventual output scenario is not approved capex or formal guidance.
changes.resource: No updated JORC/NI 43-101 resource or reserve announced. CEO interview cites Dark Horse high-grade surface ore ~50,000 oz near 7 g/t Au (managerial commentary, NOT a new MRE).
changes.output: Q3 2026 gold produced and sold 11,853 oz (corporate Q3 release). Management interview 2026-11-20 targets 70,000 oz gold in 2027; NOT formal updated production guidance.
changes.life: Unchanged; no updated reserve-based mine life in this event
changes.nextstep: Dark Horse satellite pit originally scheduled 2028: evaluate acceleration to mid-2027, timing decision targeted Q1 2027. Heap-leach construction only a management proposal for late 2027/early 2028 pending JV board approval and further studies. ~20% CIP throughput expansion under consideration; 100,000 oz/y is an aspirational growth scenario, not sanctioned.
changes.confidence: B: Direct CEO interview as reported by interviewer; targets/plans not ratified in new regulatory filing or company press release
changes.equipment_impact: Potential incremental open-pit drill/blast/load/haul and support-fleet utilization for Dark Horse, road/earthworks and materials handling for heap-leach construction, and incremental plant maintenance if ~20% processing expansion sanctioned. No confirmed order, capital budget or FID; monitor Q1 2027 JV decision.
